Garlic Butter Spaghetti 🔥 Quick, easy, and dangerously good. Buttery garlic heaven with a hint of spice… Pro Tip: Level it up with chicken, shrimp, or tofu 🫡 Ingredients: -2 shallots, thinly sliced -5 garlic cloves, minced -2 tbsp chili crisp -1 cup of cream or coconut milk, room temperature -1 tbsp soy sauce, optional -1/2 cup fresh Parmesan cheese, grated -8 oz (225g) pasta of your choice -2 tbsp butter -1 tbsp olive oil -Seasonings (1 tsp each): paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, oregano 1. Slice your shallots nice and thin and measure out your seasonings. Bring your cream or coconut milk to room temp so it blends in smoothly later. 2. Heat 2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add the shallots and sauté for 8–10 minutes until soft and starting to turn golden. 3. While the shallots are doing their thing, bring a big pot of salted water to a boil and cook your pasta until al dente. Drain, but save some pasta water… it’s liquid gold. Seriously, don’t you dare dump it. Italians everywhere are watching. 4. Once the shallots are soft and sweet, stir in your minced garlic (fresh garlic only - if you pull out that jarred stuff, the FBI will be at your door in minutes 😅) and all the seasonings. Let them bloom for about a minute, then add the chili crisp and give it another quick sauté. 5. Pour in the cream (or coconut milk), stir in the soy sauce if using, and let it simmer for a few minutes to thicken. Add in the grated Parmesan and stir. 6. Toss your pasta in the sauce until fully coated, adding splashes of reserved pasta water as needed to get that perfect silky consistency. 7. Serve hot with an extra spoonful of chili crisp on top for a little heat and a sprinkle of Parmesan and parsley if you’re feelin’ fancy. #dinnerideas #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #pasta

Cornflake Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🍗 Prep Time: 30 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 4 INGREDIENTS Easy Pantry Ranch 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/3 cup buttermilk 1 tsp dried dill 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1 tsp white vinegar or lemon juice 1/4 tsp kosher salt 1/4 tsp black pepper Chicken and Marinade 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenderloins, patted dry 1 cup buttermilk 1 tbsp hot sauce 1 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp smoked paprika 3-Step Breading Station 3/4 cup all-purpose flour + 1/2 tsp kosher salt + 1/2 tsp smoked paprika + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp onion powder 2 large eggs + 1 tbsp water, beaten 4 cups plain cornflakes, crushed into coarse crumbs 4-6 cups neutral frying oil Garlic Hot Honey Glaze 1/2 cup honey 2 tbsp fresh minced garlic 1-2 tbsp hot sauce 1 tbsp unsalted butter 1 1/2 tsp apple cider vinegar 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes INSTRUCTIONS 1. Whisk together mayo, buttermilk, dried dill, garlic powder, onion powder, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Cover and refrigerate while prepping the chicken. 2. Whisk buttermilk, hot sauce, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Toss chicken tenders in marinade, cover, and chill for 30 minutes to 4 hours. 3. Set up three dishes: seasoned flour, beaten egg wash, and coarsely crushed cornflakes. 4. Drain excess marinade from each tender, dredge in flour, dip in egg wash, and press firmly into cornflakes. Rest on a wire rack for 5-10 minutes. 5. Heat 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 350°F. Fry tenders in batches of 3-4 for 4-6 minutes, turning halfway, until golden brown and 165°F internal. Drain on a clean wire rack. 6. Melt butter over low heat and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute. Stir in honey, hot sauce, apple cider vinegar, and red pepper flakes, simmering gently for 2-3 minutes. 7. Drizzle warm garlic hot honey over crispy tenders and serve immediately with chilled ranch. #cooking #recipe #asmr #foodtok

Steak Loaded Potato Skins🔥 For those of you asking about the app, just search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 Crispy, cheesy potato skins loaded with juicy steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives… 🤤 Inspo from the goats @chefmikekubiesa & @burnt_pellet_bbq !! For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Wash & dry potatoes. Rub with olive oil, season with salt & bake at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 mins until fork-tender. Let cool slightly. 2. Meanwhile, blend all chipotle sour cream ingredients until smooth, adding a splash of milk to thin as needed. Refrigerate. 3. Halve potatoes lengthwise & scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving about 1/4 inch around the skins. Mash with warm milk, butter, sour cream, cheddar, chives & seasoning salt to taste. 4. Heat neutral oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the empty skins in batches for 2–3 mins until golden & crispy, then transfer to a wire rack. 5. Stuff the skins with the potato filling, top with triple cheddar & bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 mins until bubbling & golden. 6. Season steak generously with salt & pepper, then grill or pan-sear to your desired doneness. Rest 5–10 mins, then slice against the grain into bite-sized pieces. 7. Load the skins with steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives. Enjoy!! #dinnerideas #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #cooking

Слоеное тесто дрожжевое - 500 г Желток - 1 шт. Молоко - 1 ст. л. Оливковое масло - 50 г Укроп - пара веточек  Чеснок - 2 зубчика  Приготовление: 1. Моцареллу разрезать на небольшие одинаковые кусочки. 2. Тесто раскатать и разрезать на квадратики. 3. Завернуть моцареллу в тесто, хорошо скрепив края. Скатать шарик. 4. 30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

Crispy Potato Nuggets 🥔✨ Prep Time: 15 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 3-4 INGREDIENTS Potato Nuggets 4 medium Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into even chunks 2 slices bread 3 tbsp cornstarch 1 1/2 tsp salt (split: 1 tsp for boiling water, 1/2 tsp for dough) 1 tsp pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp aromatic seasoning 1/2 tsp chili flakes Oil, for frying INSTRUCTIONS 1. Place potato chunks in a pot of water with 1 tsp salt. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat and cook for 12–15 minutes until fork-tender. Drain well, return to the hot empty pot for 1 minute to let excess steam escape, then mash until completely smooth. 2. Quickly dip the 2 slices of bread into a bowl of water just until softened. Press firmly between your hands to wring out as much water as possible, then tear into tiny bits. 3. Add squeezed bread, 3 tbsp cornstarch, remaining 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp aromatic seasoning, and 1/2 tsp chili flakes to the mashed potatoes. Knead or mix thoroughly until smooth and uniform. 4. Rub a drop of oil on your hands if tacky. Divide dough into 16–20 equal portions, roll into balls, flatten slightly into oval nuggets, and press gently with fork tines to create ridges. 5. Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering (about 375°F). Fry nuggets in batches for 2–3 minutes per side until deeply golden brown and crunchy. Drain on a paper-towel-lined plate and serve hot. #Recipe #cooking #asmr #FoodTok

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

videos.caption: BAKED MAC N CHEESE🧀🦃 DAY 1 of my Thanksgiving Side Dish Series! 🦃🧀 Starting off strong with my homemade Baked Mac & Cheese because you simply cannot have Thanksgiving without mac & cheese! Creamy, cheesy, and loaded with FIVE different cheeses. 🤤 Ingredients: 24 oz elbow macaroni 6 tbsp butter 6 tbsp all-purpose flour 2 cups whole milk 3 cups heavy cream 8 oz sharp cheddar, shredded 8 oz Colby Jack, shredded 8 oz medium cheddar, shredded 8 oz mozzarella, shredded 4 oz Gruyère, shredded Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp ground mustard 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp salt (or to taste) Directions: 1. Boil macaroni in salted water for about 6 minutes, just shy of al dente. Drain and set aside. It’ll finish cooking in the oven! 2. In the same pot, melt butter over medium-low heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring constantly to remove the raw flour taste without browning. Stir in seasonings. 3. Slowly whisk in milk until smooth, followed by heavy cream. Cook for 5–8 minutes, stirring frequently, until warmed through and slightly thickened. Don’t let it boil! 4. Turn OFF the heat! This is key! Adding cheese over high heat can cause the proteins to tighten and the oils to separate, leaving you with a grainy, greasy sauce instead of a smooth, creamy one. Gradually stir in HALF your shredded cheese until melted and silky. 5. Fold in macaroni until completely coated. In a greased 9x13 baking dish, layer half the macaroni, half the remaining cheese, the rest of the macaroni, and finish with the remaining cheese. 6. Bake at 350°F for 15–20 minutes until hot and melted. Keep an eye on it! For that golden, crispy cheesy top, broil on high for 2–3 minutes, watching closely. And that’s it! The perfect cheesy, creamy Thanksgiving side dish! 🧀🤎 SAVE this recipe for your Thanksgiving menu! 🦃 #bakedmac #thanksgivingrecipes #thanksgiving #sidedish #floridablogger

Set out the cream cheese and butter to soften. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Boiling Method: Peel the potatoes and cut into evenly sized chunks. Place in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until fork-tender. 3. Instant Pot Method (Alternative): Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot and place the trivet inside. Add the whole, unpeeled potatoes. Cook in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer cooked potatoes to a large mixing bowl. Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper. 5. Use a hand mixer or stand mixer to mix until smooth and creamy, being careful not to overmix. 6. Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. 7. Sprinkle paprika over the top and add a few thin slices of butter. 8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. 9. Bake at 400°F for 60 minutes, or until heated through. 10. Remove the foil during the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 11. Sprinkle the freshly chopped chives over the top before serving. Make-Ahead Instructions 1. Prepare the mashed potatoes following steps 1–8 above, using either cooking method. Wait to preheat the oven until you’re ready to bake. 2. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. 3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. 4. Preheat oven to 400°F. 5. Bake covered for approximately 60 minutes, until hot in the center. 6. Remove foil for the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 7. Sprinkle with the chopped chives before serving. #mashedpotatoes #EasyRecipe

Hope y’all enjoy this one 🙌🏿🔥  Ingredients:  Green Beans- ~ 44oz Petite Golden Potatoes - 24oz bag Onion- 1 Red Bell Pepper- 1 Garlic- 4 cloves Bacon- 12oz Beef Smoked Sausage- 12oz Flour- 3 tbsp Chicken Stock (low sodium)- 7 cups Chicken Bouillon- 1 tbsp Salt- 1 tbsp White Pepper- 1 tbsp Onion Powder- 1 tbsp Garlic Powder- 1 tbsp Paprika-  2 tbsp Complete Seasoning or All Purpose Seasoning (salt free)- 2 tbsp Worcestershire Sauce- 1 tbsp Hot Sauce- 2 tbsp Cornstarch (for slurry)- 1 tbsp Water (for slurry) - 1 tbsp   Method:  Prep your ingredients before you start cooking to make the process smoother includes: chopping onions, garlic and peppers, chopping up the bacon and sausage, snipping and washing green beans, and cutting the golden potatoes in half.    Cook the bacon in a big pot on medium heat while constantly stirring allowing it to cook in its own fat. Once its cooked start a roux by adding flour and fully combining.    Slowly pour and stir chicken stock into the roux. Once fully incorporated season the gravy with the seasonings listed above along with hot sauce and worcestershire sauce.    Add in the green beans and fully combine, then cover with a lid and cook on medium for about 45 minutes. Take the lid off and add in the potatoes. Cover with a lid again for about 30 minutes or until the potatoes are fork tender.    Add the cornstarch slurry in and allow the gravy to thicken up and you should be set! Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! FRY BREAD TACOS This dinner took me right back to being a little kid, going to Pow Wow’s in the summer and eating fry bread. You could get it sweet with powdered sugar and honey, or savory, and fry bread tacos were one of my favorites. I remember beans on them too, but I kept mine simple because one of my kids doesn’t like beans. Ground beef, lettuce, cheese, homemade pico, and sour cream. Add hot sauce, add beans, add whatever you want. You’re the one eating it! Makes 8 fry bread tacos FRY BREAD • 3 cups all-purpose flour • 2 teaspoons baking powder • 1 teaspoon salt • Approximately 1 cup warm water, adding more as needed • Olive oil or your preferred frying oil TACO MEAT • 2 pounds ground beef • 1 medium onion, grated • 3 cloves garlic, grated • 1½ cups water • 1½ teaspoons Better Than Bouillon, any flavor you like. I used garlic. • 6 tablespoons Brooke’s Zesty Lime Taco Seasoning OR 2 packets taco seasoning TOPPINGS • Shredded lettuce • Shredded cheese • Pico de gallo • Sour cream • Hot sauce, optional 1. Mix the flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the warm water until the dough comes together. You want it soft and workable, without being crumbly or sticky. Add a little more water if it’s dry or a little flour if it’s too sticky. 2. Gently knead into a ball. Divide in half, then halve those pieces, then halve again to make 8 pieces. Flatten each piece between two sheets of parchment paper. Keep covered and let rest while you make the taco meat. 3. Brown the ground beef in a large skillet, adding the grated onion and garlic as it cooks. Cook until the beef is browned and the onion and garlic are tender. Drain excess grease if needed. 4. Stir in the water, Better Than Bouillon, and taco seasoning. Simmer uncovered until the excess liquid cooks off and the meat is nice and saucy without being watery. 5. Add enough oil to a separate skillet to generously cover the bottom with no dry spots. Heat over medium heat until a small piece of dough sizzles when added. 6. Carefully place the flattened dough in the hot oil, working in batches. Fry about 1–2 minutes per side until puffed and golden brown. When the bottom and edges are golden, flip and cook the other side. Adjust the heat as needed. 7. Drain on paper towels, then pile on the taco meat and your toppings. For my seasoning recipe, search “Brooke’s Zesty Lime Taco Seasoning” with “Cook with Brooke” or “Brooke Brown.” It’s seriously so freaking good. #tacos #recipe #familydinner #easyrecipe #frybread

🍫 Heaven in a Bowl – Chocolate Peanut Butter Brownie Trifle Layers of fudgy brownies, creamy peanut butter pudding, Reese's cups, and fluffy whipped topping make this an irresistible no-fuss dessert for holidays and family gatherings! 🥜 Ingredients 1 box fudge brownie mix (plus package ingredients) 2 packages (13 oz each) miniature Reese's cups 4 cups cold 2% milk 2 packages (5.1 oz each) instant vanilla pudding 1 cup creamy peanut butter 4 tsp vanilla extract 2 containers (8 oz each) whipped topping, thawed 👩‍🍳 Directions Bake Brownies: Prepare brownie mix as directed. Bake in a greased 9×12-inch pan at 350°F for 20–25 minutes. Cool completely and cut into small cubes. Prepare Candy: Halve the Reese's cups, reserving ⅓ cup for topping. Make Filling: Whisk milk and pudding mixes for 2 minutes until thick. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla, then fold in 1½ containers of whipped topping. Layer Dessert: In a large glass bowl, layer one-third each of brownies, Reese's cups, and pudding mixture. Repeat twice. Add Topping: Spread remaining whipped topping over the dessert and sprinkle with reserved Reese's cups. Chill & Serve: Refrigerate until chilled, then scoop and enjoy! Creamy Garlic Cheesy Chicken & Potatoes🧀🍗🍟 A new way to Meal Prep your High Protein Meals for The Week. Oven Sheet Pan recipes are extremely efficient, minimal cleanup, very low effort. This first one is incredibly indulgent and packed with flavour🤤🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Servings (8 Total) 536 Calories | 52g Protein | 44g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Chicken & Seasonings - 800g Raw Chicken Breast, cubed - 800g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 5 Tsp Italian Herbs Seasoning - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4-5 Tsp Paprika - 6 Tsp Olive Oil Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1600g Raw Potatoes, cubed - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs Seasoning - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - Cooking Spray or 3 Tsp Olive Oil Creamy Sauce + Garnish - 400-450ml Regular or Evaporated Milk - 250g Light Garlic & Herb Cream Cheese - 120g Shredded Mozzarella or any Cheese - Fresh Parsley, finely chopped - Grated Parmesan (optional) 👨‍🍳 Instructions • Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Season well then set aside. • Add cubed potatoes and chopped red onion to a large lined oven sheet pan (I used a 41 x 36 x 5 inch sheet pan). Season well with spices listed and cooking spray then bake in a 200C/400F preheated oven dor 20-22 mins. Not need to fully cook. • Once cooked, spread marinated chicken over the potatoes in a single layer, spray cooking spray and place back in the oven for 25 mins until perfectly cooked and juicy. • Once out, add evaporated or regular milk, light cream cheese and a good handful of mozzarella. • The remaining heat from the pan will help melt and thicken the creamy sauce. Mix everything until fully combined, creamy and the cheese melted. • Now garnish and divide into 8 or more servings depending on your calorie needs and ENJOY! . . . . #mealprep #sheetpandinner #weightloss #healthyrecipes #easyrecipes
